A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TrojanStego research work, with readable text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. Complete text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original secret-recovery experiments, benchmark evaluations, and human annotation studies in Section 6, with additional experiments and ablations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including secret-recovery accuracy in Table 2, human detection results in Table 1, and the supplementary experiments in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The vocabulary-bucket encoding, fine-tuning, and decoding procedures in Section 4 are identical. The logit-based alternative and repetition variants documented in Appendix A are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Helpful Instructions data, five leaderboard tasks, human detection studies, and secret-format, context, and length scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same uncompromised Llama, Ministral, and Qwen models serve as comparators. Comparator membership in the utility, human detection, and full fine-tuning versus LoRA comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: The key split, prompt counts, training budgets, model sizes, evaluation metrics, and human-study procedures remain identical in Sections 4.2 and 6 and Appendix A. No experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The model-size, key-length/repetition, and training-epoch analyses in Appendix A.3 are unchanged, as are the flexibility, persistency, robustness, and exploratory logit-method analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting without adding seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The existing majority-vote decoding procedures are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 2 retains 87.4% exact match for fully fine-tuned Llama 8B with trained prompts and untrained keys; appendix results are likewise identical.

T1.justification: The threat assumptions, vocabulary-partition formalization in Section 4.1, and logit-method definitions and equations (1)–(5) in Appendix A.5 are unchanged. No mathematical reasoning or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about the TrojanStego threat, evaluation taxonomy, learnable encoding scheme, and covert exfiltration capability.

C2.justification: The tokenizer-based explanations, utility and detectability tradeoffs, mitigation discussion, and limitations concerning persistence, secret placement, and secret length are unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 newly acknowledges EuroHPC-awarded access to MeluXina at LuxProvide, adding limited computing-resource provenance. The hardware specifications, hyperparameters, GPU-hour estimates, and artifact access information otherwise remain unchanged; the acknowledgment does not establish a change to experimental hardware.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion and cited-work membership are identical. The final citation sheet updates this paper's own publication metadata, which does not change its positioning relative to prior research.

P1.justification: Acknowledgments add DFG grant 564661959 and EuroHPC/MeluXina credit. The citation sheet changes from a short article entry to an EMNLP 2025 proceedings entry with fuller metadata, and version/date labels change. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Longer acknowledgments cause reference reflow across PDF pages 10–12, and the expanded citation entry enlarges its box on page 19. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–16, and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v4 provides fuller funding and computing acknowledgments and publication citation metadata. These limited documentation updates leave the scientific argument, experimental evidence, reproducibility instructions, and limitations unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
